sources.locator: Title search: 哈希签名（基于哈希的签名）

statement.zh: **术语**：哈希签名（基于哈希的签名）（Hash-Based Signatures）。FIPS 205（2024 年 8 月 13 日发布）的 SLH-DSA「is a stateless hash-based signature scheme that is constructed using other hash-based signature schemes as components」：少次签名方案 FORS 与多次签名方案 XMSS，而 XMSS 又以一次性签名 WOTS+ 为部件。标准说明「Conceptually, an SLH-DSA key pair consists of a very large set of FORS key pairs」，每个 FORS 密钥对只安全签名少量消息；超树是 XMSS 树组成的树，私钥含秘密种子与 PRF 密钥，公钥由 PK.seed 与超树根组成。
statement.en: **Term**: Hash-Based Signatures.It is registered under digital signatures, post-quantum cryptography.

statement.zh: 安全性不依赖素数分解或离散对数：The security of ...SLH-DSA relies on the presumed difficulty of finding preimages for hash functions as well as several related properties of the same hash functions，并且「Unlike the algorithms specified in FIPS 186-5 [1], SLH-DSA is designed to provide resistance against attacks from a large-scale quantum computer」。参数名同时编码哈希族（SHA2 或 SHAKE）、安全参数 n 的位数，以及为签名更小（s）或生成更快（f）的设计取向。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in digital signatures, post-quantum cryptography, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 标准给出 12 组参数集，n 为 16、24、32 的分别落在安全类别 1、3、5，且「each parameter set is claimed to be at least as secure as a generic block cipher with a prescribed key size」。§9.2 说明 hedged 变体是默认值，「should be used on platforms where side-channel attacks are a concern」。
statement.en: Fix the object and its aliases; list the sourced dates, roles, parameters or inscriptions; state the observable output; then test the boundary.Any step without a source stops there rather than being filled with prose.

statement.zh: 私钥机密性是核心：§3.2 单列「Side-channel and fault attacks」并提醒「the secrecy of the private key is critical」。签名总量存在设计条件，§11 的脚注是举例说明量级：若以每秒 100 亿个消息签名，签满 2^64 个消息需要 58 年以上。§3 脚注 2 强调本文的 WOTS+ 与 XMSS「are not the same as」RFC 8391 与 SP 800-208 中的同名方案；§6 说明每个 WOTS+ 密钥只签一条消息、高度 h 的 XMSS 密钥签 2^h 条。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.

statement.zh: NIST IR 8547（2026 年 10 月）在 §2.1.1 记录 SLH-DSA 源自 SPHINCS+ 提交，并把 FIPS 204 与 205 并列为量子抗性签名标准；§4 规定量子脆弱的公钥密码在 2030 年后弃用、2035 年后「disallow its use under NIST standards and guidelines」，同时 §3.2 说明迁移初期可采用混合方案，「typically designed to remain secure if at least one of the component algorithms is secure」。
statement.en: Registered period: Post-quantum Era.The exact date is left to the ledger; institutional placement and technical detail follow the cited sources.
